decisions.reason: It is tightly aligned with the firm's stated push for secure cross-channel communication, builds on existing capabilities, and prior public launch makes management inclined to continue unless failure is unmistakable.
As a core security architecture with its own product page, it reflects substantial R&D commitment and strategic importance, which under escalation of commitment strongly favors continuation.

Although a hardware-based token is somewhat narrower and may face slower uptake, it still fits the firm's signing and identity roadmap and the visible investment in a dedicated page supports persistence.

The compliance suite is somewhat more specialized and less visibly emphasized than the core identity products, but its fit with regulated security needs and sunk development effort still make management more likely to retain it than withdraw it.
